ORCHESTRATOR RESOLUTION (post-batch reconciliation): SR 278 'La Redoute Interiors UK' was found by its worker to be a home-scoped subset of the same laredoute.co.uk domain as this company (SR 82), reading identical URLs with identical counts for this concept (no LRI-specific brand filtering exists for Bestsellers/Clearance/New Arrivals -- unlike the separate category-taxonomy project where LRI genuinely had its own filtered subset). SR 278's worker used Claude-in-Chrome to get past the Cloudflare 'Country challenge' that blocked this company's own earlier session (the challenge auto-resolves after a few seconds in a real browser -- worth using tier 3 directly on any future retry of this domain). Per this project's standing home/decor-only scoping convention (applied to every multi-category company in this roster), this company's own out-of-scope fashion rows from the earlier session (if any) have been removed, and the verified home-scoped rows below are adopted from SR 278's successful pass. Original SR 82 notes/failure_reason preserved above this note for history.

SUPERSEDES an earlier partial pass written to this same file earlier in this session (which stopped at the Cloudflare block without trying tier 3, and left all leaf counts null). ACCESS: tiers 1-2 all hit the Cloudflare 'Country challenge' 403 on /pplp/ URLs (same as notes/278.md's prior-pass finding); tier 3 (Claude-in-Chrome, real browser) got past it after a ~4s auto-resolve wait and reached every leaf page with exact counts. The site's own taxonomy labels the hub at /outlet.aspx 'Final Clearance -- Up to 65% off' (a permanent department-by-department markdown section via a dedicated 'Outlet' nav link, not a calendar promo) -- this passes the Clearance-vs-Sale test and is included. A separate homepage banner 'SEPTEMBER SAVINGS -- Up to 40% off with code SAVE' is a coupon-code calendar promo with no clearance/outlet wording and was correctly EXCLUDED (not recorded as a row). CLEARANCE-VS-SALE NUANCE WORTH FLAGGING: although the /outlet.aspx hub card labels each department '<X> Final Clearance', three of the four home-department LEAF pages render their own H1/title as generic 'Sale' wording once opened ('Sale - Bedding & Linen', 'Sale | Home Furnishings', 'Sale - Home Decor') rather than 'Clearance'/'Outlet' -- only 'Furniture Outlet' keeps Clearance/Outlet wording on its own H1. Per brief, these 3 are recorded with an AMBIGUOUS SALE/CLEARANCE flag despite being reached via the Final-Clearance hub, since the leaf page's own on-page wording is the stronger signal and it says 'Sale'. SCOPE DECISION: SR278 'La Redoute Interiors UK' is the home-only 'La Redoute Interieurs' (LRI) brand/collection line (see bs278.json notes for full reasoning: LRI's own brand-page nav has zero fashion categories). The /outlet.aspx hub also exposes 4 fashion-only Final Clearance departments (Women's Outlet Clothes & Shoes 3707 [with a Women's Knitwear Outlet child, 402], Men's Outlet Clothes & Shoes 1040, Kids & Baby Clothing & Footwear Outlet 1012) which are EXCLUDED below as out of SR278's brand scope, not because they failed the Clearance test -- they are genuine, confirmed Clearance PLPs, just fashion-scoped (would belong to SR82's output instead). BRAND-FILTER CHECK: appending ?brndid=la-redoute-interieurs to /outlet.aspx returned byte-identical 'Final Clearance' content (no brand filter chip or LRI-specific variant applied), and the LRI brand page's own nav has no Outlet/Clearance link at all -- confirming Clearance is a single sitewide, non-brand-partitioned feature with no separate LRI-scoped version to extract. DUPLICATE-VS-SR82 DETERMINATION (for orchestrator): for the 4 home-department rows below, SR278 and SR82 would read the exact same URLs with the exact same counts (no LRI-specific filtering exists for Clearance) -- these are not unique LRI data, they are the home-scoped subset of what SR82's full (fashion+home) Clearance output would contain. Orchestrator should decide whether SR278 is kept as an explicit home-only cross-reference or treated as redundant with SR82's corresponding home rows. NAVIGATION CHECKED: homepage header/footer, the /outlet.aspx hub (source of all 8 department links), no separate 'Clearance' nav item elsewhere; no site-search needed given a direct labelled Outlet nav link existed.
